what_it_is.prose: MIDHANI is India's DPSU for special metals and superalloys, manufacturing nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, special-purpose steels (incl. DMR-249A defence-grade naval steel for INS Arihant class nuclear submarines), soft-magnetic alloys, and refractory metal alloys. These feed India's strategic sectors — aerospace (HAL Tejas, ISRO launchers, GTRE Kaveri engine), defence (naval vessels, armour), nuclear, and space. MIDHANI supplied superalloys for the indigenous Kaveri aero-engine programme (single-crystal alloy capable of withstanding 1,400-1,500 °C), the GE-F414 turbofan (for LCA Tejas Mk2), and large titanium rings (≥2,250 mm) for aerospace applications. MIDHANI secured a ₹600 Cr superalloy supply contract with HAL (2024) strengthening indigenous aerospace. DMRL (DRDO) is the upstream R&D lab; MIDHANI is the production scale-up agency.

rows.india_status: Developed 3 advanced nickel-based superalloys exclusively for aero-engine applications. Single-crystal alloy capable of withstanding 1,400-1,500 °C for Kaveri engine. Supplies superalloys for GE-F414 (Tejas Mk2). S130/S132/S80 round bars and 5,260 kg of materials supplied to GTRE
Used in indigenously built Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) vessels and Arihant-class nuclear submarines; sub-zero toughness, combat-grade
First-ever Titan 31 Eli large size rings of above 2,250 mm manufactured in-house; titanium alloys for ISRO launchers and HAL airframes
MIDHANI secured ₹600 Cr superalloy supply contract with HAL to support India's indigenous aerospace programmes
